BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE
TELECOMMUNICATIONS ORDER, 2001
(S 38/2001)
TELECOMMUNICATIONS (RADIO-COMMUNICATION) (AMENDMENT)
REGULATIONS, 2020
In exercise of the power conferred by section 77 of the Telecommunications
Order, 2001, the Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of
Brunei Darussalam, with the approval of the Minister of Transport and
Infocommunications, hereby makes the following Regulations -
Citation and commencement
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Telecommunications (Radio
communication) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020 and shall be deemed to have
commenced on 24th January 2020.
Amendment of Schedule to S 86/2013
2. The Schedule to the Telecommunications (Radio-communication)
Regulations, 2013 is amended, in PART I-
(a} on page 1975, in respect of the item relating to "Mobile" which
appears in the first column, by deleting the following items which appears in
the second and third columns respectively -
"Cellular mobile $25*";
subscriber licence
(b) on page 1976, by deleting "*The annual licence fee for cellular
mobile subscriber licence is based on per registration of cellular services not

per equipment." from the last two lines.
Made this 28th. day of Jamadilawal, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the
24th. day of January, 2020.
DATO SERI PADUKA AW ANG HAJJ MATSATEJO BIN SOKJAW
Chairman,
Authority for Info·communications Technology
